title: SMI push payload (spec section 9.1)
description: Payload delivered through APNs (voip) and FCM data messages. Contains ONLY minimal call info — never SIP secrets, session tokens or private keys. FCM transports every value as a string; native parsers must validate type/range and never crash on malformed input.

type.description: cancel_call is an Android-only best-effort data message; iOS never receives a new VoIP push for cancellation (spec 5.4)

deviceGeneration.description: string-encoded in FCM data; stale generation = ignore push

expiresAt.description: call setup deadline (UTC, RFC 3339, Z). Server deadline remains authoritative even when push TTL differs.
